description:
Returns funding rules for a project. Use the optional `include` query parameter to embed related resources (e.g. `include=items` for rule allocation items with funding source details).
Requires the `view_funding_rules` granular permission on the Prime Contract tool.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of related resources to embed. Use `items` to include rule allocation items with funding source id and name.

parameters.name: filters[status][]
parameters.description: Filter by status. Prefer the repeatable array form, e.g. `filters[status][]=ACTIVE&filters[status][]=INACTIVE`. A single scalar value (`filters[status]=ACTIVE`) is also accepted for backwards compa...

parameters.name: filters[rule_id][]
parameters.description: Filter by one or more stable logical funding rule IDs. This is the `rule_id` shared by all versions of a rule, not a version-instance `id`. Values are numeric strings, the same type as JSON `rule_i...

items.description: Numeric string ID. Matches JSON `rule_id` and the `{rule_id}` path parameter.

parameters.name: filters[number][]
parameters.description: Filter by one or more funding rule numbers using exact, case-sensitive matching. Repeat the parameter for each value; scalar values are not accepted. Unknown or blank values do not match any rules.

parameters.name: filters[currency_iso_code]
parameters.description: Filter to rules with funding sources in the given currency.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to sort by. Prefix with '-' for descending.

items.description: A funding rule — a named set of allocation percentages that splits a project's spend across funding sources. Updates create a new immutable version.

id.description: Unique string identifier of this specific rule version instance. Changes each time the rule is updated; use `rule_id` (not this) to address the rule in path parameters.

rule_id.description: Stable logical identifier of the rule, shared across all of its versions. Use as the `{rule_id}` path parameter for GET and PATCH `/rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/funding_so...

project_id.description: Identifier of the project the rule belongs to. Matches the `{project_id}` path parameter of the rule's endpoints.

number.description: Human-readable rule number, unique within the project. Auto-assigned on create. Filter collections with `filters[number][]`.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Filter collections with `filters[status][]`; omitted filter defaults to `ACTIVE`.

version.description: Sequential version number of the rule, incremented each time the rule is updated. The response always reflects the latest version.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the logical rule was first created. Unchanged across later versions.

updated_by_id.description: Unique string identifier of the user who last updated the rule (created this version).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this rule version was created.
